name: fd
meaning: _open handle; File_Open 0x531f00 returns -1 when it is -1

name: size
meaning: file size from lseek(end) in File_Open 0x531f00 (also returned)

name: remaining
meaning: bytes not yet read; File_Open sets it to size. Load_MLT compares it unsigned (cmp [ebp-0x18],4 / jbe at 0x548c2d) and allocates remaining-4 for the second checked read

name: field_0c
meaning: never read or written by File_Open/Read/ReadAt/Seek/ReadChecked/Close; INFERRED from the frames: Load_MLT's FileHandle local ends exactly 0x10 bytes below its neighbours ([ebp-0x20], next local at -0x10, 0x548bc6), and File_LoadWhole/Load_DAV leave room for >= 16 bytes too
